title: Протокол совещания: поручения в JSON с исполнителями, сроками и статусами
notes: Traps: item 7 moves the П-3 deadline from 05.04.2027 to 09.04.2027 (a date in another format, corrected later); П-2 has no deadline (3 March is when it was done) -> null; the text names owners in the dative (Беловой, Лисицыной), the output wants the attendee-list nominative. Statuses: П-1 and П-6 started -> 'в работе', П-2 done, the rest 'новое'. Owner names are compared with all whitespace removed and ё folded to е; order of objects is free.
